policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'Let not the rebellious exalt themselves' renders either the qere qal יָרוּמוּ (rise up, be exalted) or the ketiv hiphil ירימו read reflexively (lift themselves up); the English has no italicized supply and no textual note on the verse, so nothing in the wording distinguishes the stems. Base qere fallback retained.
